decision_conditions: The development must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date hereof.Reason: To comply with Section 18 of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990, as amended.

Prior to the commencement of development, measures for the protection of all tree(s) shown to be retained shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The measures shall be in accordance with the British Standard BS5837:  Trees in relation to design, demolition and construction. Any works/development on site shall be carried out in strict accordance with the approved details and the protective measures shall only be removed on completion of the development.  Reason: Required prior to commencement of development to satisfy the Local Planning Authority that the tree (s) to be retained will not be damaged during demolition or construction and to ensure tree(s) significant in terms of their provision of local amenity are protected from construction damage, in accordance with best practice and Policy 28 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The development hereby approved shall be constructed in accordance with the materials stipulated on drawings SA-04, SA-05, Supporting Confirmation (Email) of Bicycle Shed Exterior Materials and Ancillary Use of Log Cabin, dated 13-04-2026 and revised Supporting Document - Proposed Shed and Proposed Bike Storage Shed, received on 13-04-2026 and thereafter maintained and retained unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.Reason:  To safeguard the visual amenities of the area and to ensure compliance with Policy 28 and 30 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The log cabin outbuilding in the rear garden hereby permitted shall be only used for purposes ancillary and incidental to the main dwelling and for no other purposes. It shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling, known as 2 Park Close, Carshalton, SM5 3EU. It shall at no time be used as a separate residential unit. To ensure the ancillary nature of the outbuilding, it shall at no time have:i)   a separate postal address;ii)  its own kitchen or cooking facilities when a bathroom or WC is also present;iii) separate metres for the provision of services;iv) a separate and registered Land Registry title;v)  a separate Council Tax account;vi) a separate access independent of the main dwelling house.Reason:  To ensure the ancillary nature of the outbuilding hereby permitted is not used as a separate unit of residential accommodation or for purposes other than that incidental to the enjoyment of the main dwellinghouse in accordance with Policy 9 and 29 of the Sutton Local Plan.

The development must be carried out in accordance with the provisions of the Fire Safety Strategy (Part A) - Reasonable Exception Statement, prepared by Mr Simon Allen and submitted with the application.Reason: To ensure that the development incorporates the necessary fire safety measures in accordance with the Mayor's London Plan Policy D12.
description: Erection of outbuilding and a replacement shed to the rear and provision of cycle store to the front of the property.
